rationale: Activity gives the event standalone purchase value while smaller related formats create relationship depth and repeat
first_test: One six-event public-and-depth season in one city
largest_unknown: Whether public-event customers buy a related smaller repeated format

rationale: Course league campaign or programme creates repeated exposure with bounded commitment and legible value

archetype: Vertical activity network plus supplier tools

first_test: Run the workflow manually with five active suppliers in one vertical
largest_unknown: Whether supplier pain and local participant density coexist in the same market
